ways.label: Cassel Flat to Horace Walker via Regina Creek

via.name: Horace Walker River
via.quote: You will need to cross the Horace Walker River to reach the hut.

evidence: ### Cassel Flat to Horace Walker via Regina Creek
From Cassel Flat Hut cross the flats and use the cableway to cross the Karangarua River to the true right.
Traverse east to the four bunk Horace Walker Hut.

doubts: Page describes two valley routes (Karangarua to Christmas Flat; Douglas valley branching from Cassel Flat), so kind network. W1 time is DOC's '2 days +'; legs are 6, 7 and 3 hr. Horace Walker Hut is on W2 only. Karangarua River cableway crossing on W2 not marked as ford. Regina Creek crossed by three-wire bridge. The unmarked other Douglas routes are not described.
